title: Margate Police Department
key_finding: Margate's official police site presents a standalone city Police Department with headquarters, general-information contact, and department sections.

title: About the Police Department / Office of the Chief
key_finding: The City says Michael Palma was sworn in as Police Chief on September 19, 2024; lists the Police Department as a 24-hour city department; and provides a police public-records request path.

title: About Us
key_finding: Margate's official police About Us page says Margate was incorporated on May 30, 1955 and that the Margate Police Department has 148 members and is a full-service law-enforcement agency.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal report lists Margate Police Department with population 59,351 and total index crime 780.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal report retains Margate Police Department as a named Broward municipal row with population 58,714 but blanks every offense field.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q2 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FDLE FIBRS offense workbook found no Margate row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q2 sheets.

title: FBI Crime Data Explorer Florida agency roster
key_finding: A live March 24, 2026 query to the official FBI CDE Florida roster returned Margate Police Department under ORI FL0062100 in Broward County as a City agency with is_nibrs false and nibrs_start_date null.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes FL0062100 exclusively to Margate city.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: FL0062100 is classified as a local police department and is flagged with SRS and NIBRS source-presence years from 2018 through 2024 even though nibrs_max_months_reported is 0.0.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: FL0062100 has substantive annual totals in 2018, 2019, and 2020, then only zero-valued annual rows from 2021 through 2024.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: Every 2024 Margate control row is fully fill-backed because preferred reported support is zero and the city is treated as structurally missing or unreliable.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.parquet
key_finding: Margate is queued in high_impact_full_fill_place with total_fill_count 1032.0 and total_reported_count 0.0.

title: fbi_cde_source_review_queue.csv
key_finding: The repo's FBI/CDE review queue separately flags FL0062100 as present_but_no_2024_observation with official_is_nibrs false.
